title: tell implementers in the brief that CLI socket tests may only fail in their sandbox and that the reviewer re-runs them

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261120-001408-907b, project ork, item S353:

tell implementers in the brief that CLI socket tests may only fail in their sandbox and that the reviewer re-runs them

Evidence: the implementer reported 322 failures from setsockopt and connect being denied; the same `go test ./...` passed in full in the reviewer session
